outgoing.name: Buddhism
outgoing.excerpt: This scheme was called the eightfold way by Gell-Mann, a clever conflation of the octets of the model with the eightfold way of Buddhism.

outgoing.name: James Joyce
outgoing.excerpt: He also chose the name quark and attributed it to the sentence “Three quarks for Muster Mark” in James Joyce's Finnegans Wake .

outgoing.name: Richard Feynman
outgoing.excerpt: …certain properties of high energy reactions of hadrons led Richard Feynman to postulate substructures of hadrons, which he called partons…
